template.title: Say why a message went
template.description: When a chat filter catches a message, tells the viewer why in chat, so they know it wasn't a glitch.

with.message: @${event.actor.login} ${{"words": "that word isn't allowed here.", "links": "please don't post links without a mod's !permit.", "emotes": "please don't spam emotes.", "caps": "please don't type in all capitals.", "symbols": "please don't spam symbols.", "repeats": "please don't repeat the same message."}[event.payload.rule]}
